title: Some people told him to be quiet.
paragraphs:
Some people told him to be quiet.
He shouted even louder.

What if the moment everyone tries to silence you…
is the moment your faith is closest to being answered?

Sometimes the loudest faith
comes from the people everyone else ignores.

But he believed enough
to shout until Jesus saw him.
Not everyone will understand your faith.
Some people were never meant to stop it.

“Bartimaeus didn’t whisper his faith.
He shouted it.
Sometimes the breakthrough comes after the crowd says stop.”
